references.text: The warning against following the customs of other peoples and not worshipping their gods, especially in connection with the Canaanites.
The prohibition against imitating the religious practices of the pagan nations after Israel has taken possession of the land.
The warning against learning the detestable customs of the peoples in the land of Canaan.
God commands Israel not to walk according to the customs of the peoples whom He drives out before them.
Ezekiel reminds how Israel was told to reject the idols of Egypt and not follow their customs.
The warning against learning the ways of the nations and following their customs.
It elaborates on the specific sins committed by the people of Canaan, which Israel must avoid.
Paul urges believers not to be conformed to this world, but to be transformed.
Peter urges believers not to conform to the passions they formerly had in their ignorance.
Paul warns against walking as the nations walk in the futility of their minds.
